sourceTitle: Rockin Meat Marinade for the Juiciest Meat Ever
sourceText:
Rockin Meat Marinade for the Juiciest Meat Ever
By: Homemade & Yummy
Published: Wednesday, June 14, 2017 - 7:12am

Ingredients




1/4 cup olive oil
1/4 cup dry red wine
1/4 cup balsamic vinegar
1/4 cup soya sauce
1/4 cup Worcestershire sauce
2 tbsp Dijon mustard
1 tsp garlic powder

Preparation

1 Place all ingredients into a glass jar. Whisk/shake to combine well. 2 Use whenever you need a great marinade. 3 Keep unused marinade in a sealed jar in the fridge.

About

This Rockin Meat Marinade for the Juiciest Meat Ever needs to be a staple in your kitchen. Want excellent results this grilling season? This will do it!!
